reviews.title: Very scammy and shady.
reviews.text: Thankfully I was able how to figure out how to cancel because of a fellow reviewer. But this app has red flags all over it. First of all, when you sign up for a free trial, it doesn’t appear in your Apple subscriptions, or even purchase history. It goes through something separate called “FastSpring” and you have to go and manually unsubscribe through the email they send you. I’ve never ever seen an app subscription or even a free download that didn’t pop up in the purchase history. Why? Is it to make it as difficult as possible to cancel? Hoping people just forget that they’re losing $6/week for nothing. That’s dishonest and I don’t care how great your app supposedly is. If that’s how you have to operate then you’re shady.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: I downloaded the app with a three-day free trial. After a couple hours I decided I didn’t want the app. There is nowhere on the app to cancel the subscription and unlike most apps, it was not visible in my Subscriptions section of my iPhone settings. I tried finding a phone number or website but there wasn’t an easily accessible way to contact Logicus. I submitted a complaint in the AppStore. Of course, after a week, I was charged and the email invoice contained a link to be able to cancel. That is NOT what a free trial is. It was a scam to take, at the very least $6.99 while telling me it was a free trial without any way of cancelling within the three days. I’m so mad about it and there very little I can do but move on and take the lesson.
